combinations.readout: mechanical withdrawal threshold and thermal withdrawal latency (pain hypersensitivity)
combinations.magnitude: Comp 6d or SRT1720 did not reverse pain hypersensitivity in SIRT1 knockdown mice
combinations.evidence_quote: However, intrathecal injection of Comp 6d or SRT1720 did not reverse the pain hypersensitivity and the decrease of SIRT1 in SIRT1flox/flox, Cre mice.

combinations.magnitude: no significant influence of Comp 6d on mGluR1/5 after SIRT1 knockdown
combinations.evidence_quote: However, intrathecal injection of Comp 6d had no significant influence on the levels of mGluR1/5 after knocking down spinal SIRT1 (Fig. 5I-L).

combinations.magnitude: effect of Comp 6d on c-Fos abolished in knockdown mice
combinations.evidence_quote: However, the effect of Comp 6d on c-Fos protein was abolished after knocking down spinal SIRT1 (Fig. 6C).
